text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch fo their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein receives Vietnamese finance minister
- Iraq's information minister sends letters to counterparts in Arab countries exposing the dubious media campaign waged by American press against Baghdad
- Saddam declares January 18 of every year a day of science
- Iraq takes part in the Arab endowments and religious affairs ministers' conference in Jordan
- More condemnation of American aggression against Iraq
- Egypt renews concern for Iraq's sovereignty and territorial integrity
- Defence minister stresses importance of training for the armed forces
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and AL-IRAQ)
- Editorial blasts U.S. for insistence on no-fly zones
- Iraq will soon sign oil deals with foreign firms in a bid to expedite implementation of the oil-for-food deal
- Editorial says liberation of Kurdish city of Arbil marks beginning of an overall Iraqi victory over the U.S.
BABEL (Newspaper of Saddam's eldest son Uday)
- Editorial urges government to remove restrictions on travel to allow Iraqis unhappy with government to leave the country freely.
